options.title: Drop Mexico on Spain and it won't stop at Spain
options.first_line: Drop Mexico onto Spain at its real size, and it doesn't stop at Spain's coast.
options.first_frame: Mexico's outline lifting off the Americas on the old map, its flag inside it, with Spain glowing on the far side of the Atlantic.

options.title: Mexico laid on Spain stretches to another continent
options.first_line: Lay Mexico on Spain at its true size, and it stretches all the way onto another continent.
options.first_frame: Mexico's flag-filled outline hanging over Spain and Portugal on the old map of Europe, its far tip hidden past the bottom of the frame.

options.title: Spain fits inside Mexico. Mexico doesn't fit on Spain
options.first_line: Spain fits neatly inside Mexico, but Mexico laid on Spain spills off it in every direction.
options.first_frame: Two outlines side by side on the old map: Spain sitting inside Mexico, and Mexico laid over Spain spilling into the sea.

why: It names two countries anyone can picture and leaves the real question open (where does Mexico stop?), while B gives away the 'another continent' answer and C mostly restates a size comparison.
